chunks: As for what Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Ṣafwān, from ʿAbdullāh, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who goes hunting. He said: If he moves around within his area, then he should not shorten; but if he goes beyond the distance, then let him shorten.

key_terms.الْوَقْتَ: the set limit or travel distance intended here
key_terms.حَوْلَهُ: around him or within his surrounding area
key_terms.فَلَا يَقْصُرُ: he should not shorten the salat (prayer)
key_terms.فَلْيَقْصُرْ: then let him shorten the salat (prayer)
key_terms.يَدُورُ: moves about locally or stays circulating nearby

ai.seo_question: When does a hunter shorten salat (prayer) during travel according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the traveler engaged in hunting and whether he performs full or shortened salat (prayer). It distinguishes between remaining within one’s surrounding area and going beyond the travel distance, making the ruling dependent on the extent of travel.
